caption: The video captures a hydraulic press in operation, its dark cylindrical piston with a tapered lower tip bearing down on a white smartwatch laid flat on a circular metal platform. The watch's square metallic case sits directly beneath the tip, its white silicone band stretching left toward a metal buckle and right across the platform, against a fixed dark-green workshop wall with a cabinet. The piston descends slowly, and the contact point compresses the case, the surrounding white housing cracking and crumbling into a small pile of debris while the band remains roughly in place. A brief blur appears around the crush zone. Then a burst of shattered fragments, including a curved transparent shard and a greenish piece, is ejected outward with strong motion blur, scattering through the air and onto the platform. As the flying debris settles, a dark crushed mass sits at the right edge of the piston tip. A small blue-green fragment protrudes at the left edge of the compressed case, the piston still pressed firmly down.

draft_caption: The video captures a hydraulic press in operation, its dark cylindrical piston with a tapered lower tip bearing down on a white smartwatch laid flat on a circular metal platform. The watch's square metallic case sits directly beneath the tip, its white silicone band stretching left toward a metal buckle and right across the platform, against a fixed dark-green workshop wall with a cabinet. The piston continues its slow vertical descent, and the contact point steadily flattens the case, the surrounding white housing cracking and crumbling into a small pile of debris while the band remains roughly in place. A momentary blur at the crush zone hints at a sudden deformation. Then a burst of shattered fragments, including a curved transparent shard and a greenish piece, is ejected outward with strong motion blur, scattering through the air and onto the platform. As the flying debris settles, a dark crushed mass clings to the piston tip. A small blue-green fragment protrudes at the left edge of the flattened case, the piston still pressed firmly down.
